d: In this week's edition of Sports This Week, Rupha Ramani brings you the biggest stories making headlines across the sporting world. From Gukesh finding his rhythm against Javokhir Sindarov at the World Chess Championship and Mohammed Siraj being left out of India's playing XI yet again to 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashing a sensational 204, we look at the stories that have kept the sporting world talking. We also bring you Max Verstappen's latest war of words with George Russell and the heartwarming story of schoolboys who bunked classes to watch the India-New Zealand Test.
